components.name: Apex Nexus check-in
components.description: Apex Nexus EHR as a Verifier. Patient check-in asks the patient's health app (the phone's wallet or any registered web wallet) for records or the PHQ-2, verifies SMART Health Cards, renders the result in Nexus, and sends it to the chart's review queue. Nexus also scans SMART Health Card and SMART Health Link QR codes and renders them in Nexus.
components.notes: Accept the one-time confidentiality notice. Check-in: choose Pre-visit records (scenarios 1 and 3; decline Immunizations for 3) or Depression screen (PHQ-2) (scenario 2). 'On their phone' shows a code the patient scans with the phone that holds their wallet (native path); 'On this device' lists the device's own wallet and the registry's web wallets. QR reader: Scan SMART / FHIR (Nexus sidebar, Quick Actions) reads SMART Health Card (shc:/) and SMART Health Link (shlink:/) QR codes from the camera, an image, or pasted text and renders them in Nexus. Synthetic data only.
